family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal end of a group of animal zinc finger FYVE domain-containing proteins, including Smad anchor for receptor activation (SARA), which plays a significant role in TGF-mediated signalling. This domain is involved in the interaction with the TGF-beta receptor [[cite:PUB00042868],[cite:PUB00024191]]. This domain is found associated with [pfam:PF01363].
family.name: Smad anchor for receptor activation-like, C-terminal
